snippet.title: Night Plane - Release Date Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310570/Night_Plane/

A release date trailer for Night Plane. Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
